pooled_unit_rule: biological_unit_id values containing POOLED are pooled units; all other values are donor-labelled units
paired_ablation: full-minus-composition Spearman within identical measurement batches, summarized both batch-weighted and biological-unit-weighted

uncertainty.method: equal-weight biological-unit bootstrap over unit-level means

claim_boundary: This is an author-run same-lineage cluster sensitivity audit. It does not turn pooled or donor-labelled units from one laboratory into independent external laboratories, and it cannot establish independent validation, external scientific reproduction or scientific submission readiness.
